plan.title: fix(build-dist): exclude vitest coverage/ from archive walk (Windows ENOENT race)

narratives.Description: build-dist DEFAULT_EXCLUDES omits Vitest coverage/, so concurrent coverage/.tmp files race the archiver on Windows (ENOENT). Add coverage to DEFAULT_EXCLUDES and assert coverage/.tmp is not archived.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

`task build` / build-dist-runner archives everything except DEFAULT_EXCLUDES. That set includes pytest `.coverage` but not Vitest `coverage/`. On Windows, concurrent Vitest coverage runs create/delete `coverage/.tmp/coverage-N.json` while archiver opens paths collected earlier → ENOENT.

## Expected

`coverage` in DEFAULT_EXCLUDES alongside `.coverage` so release Step 8 never races Vitest instrumentation.
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows maintainer cutting a release, I want build-dist to ignore Vitest coverage artifacts, so that concurrent or leftover coverage/.tmp files do not ENOENT the archive walk.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add `coverage` to DEFAULT_EXCLUDES in build-dist.ts.
2. Add a focused test asserting coverage/.tmp files are not archived.
3. Smoke task build / build-dist-runner on a tree with coverage/.tmp present.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. DEFAULT_EXCLUDES includes coverage
2. Focused test for coverage/.tmp exclusion
3. build succeeds with stale/active coverage/.tmp

narrative.Acceptance: Given DEFAULT_EXCLUDES in build-dist.ts, when inspected, then it includes `coverage` alongside `.coverage`.
Given a fixture tree with coverage/.tmp/coverage-N.json, when iterSourceFiles / build-dist runs, then those paths are excluded from the archive set.
Given an active or stale coverage/.tmp directory, when task build / build-dist-runner runs, then it completes without ENOENT on coverage temp files.
